correctness.rationale: Positive terminal killing makes the weighted tree Laplacian SPD. Radial symmetry and nonzero adjacent-shell coupling make root Krylov k-space exactly the first k shells; image under A has k dimensions. Indicator of the first k+1 shells is harmonic on the earlier k shells, hence orthogonal to that image and uniquely spans its complement in the k+1 dimensional support. Projection of root delta onto this vector equals the uniform reciprocal-ball indicator. Radial invariance proves termination at H+1. Simple Rayleigh quotients prove diverging condition number as killing tends to zero. Reproduction: 10,602 exact rational assertions across 879 weighted trees using actual full matrices; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A natural point-source Poisson benchmark is solved exactly for an infinite family with arbitrary radial branching and positive real layer weights. It yields the complete GMRES residual vector and terminating step, a reciprocal volume-growth law, algebraic-versus-exponential geometry distinction, and exact invariance despite arbitrarily bad spectral conditioning. These are substantive natural structural conclusions, rather than routine tuning or recomputation of a known table.
